response.changelog:
Pixel OS v2.1.1 — Pure Retail Google PixelOS Stable Update for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Out-of-the-Box 4K 60fps & 1080p 60fps Hardware Gyro-EIS3 Video Stabilization: patched Qualcomm Spectra 380 CHI HAL (UsecaseVideo4kEIS3PreviewEIS2 + stream-order-independent binder) & pre-seeded Pixel 9 GCam 9.6 custom EIS sessions (32808 60fps / 32779 30fps) — zero manual XML loading required, works automatically in GCam 9.6 (0.6x/1x/2x) and third-party Camera2 video apps
• 100% Pure Google PixelOS Experience on Default Stable Channel: unmodified Retail Google Pixel Launcher (vertical App Drawer + bottom Search bar), stock Material 3 Expressive SystemUI & Notification Shade, stock Android Settings, Google Phone, Google Messages, and circular Pixel adaptive icons
• Opt-In 'iOS Style UI Beta' Toggle in Settings -> System -> System update: keep OFF for pure Google PixelOS daily-driver stability, or turn ON anytime to try iOS 26 Liquid Glass UI updates
• Shared Core Fixes Included: Chrome 156+ / WebView zygote_next Linux 4.14 compatibility fix, calibrated OLED low-brightness & HBM boot guard, Unlimited Google Photos backup, and atomic /data/ota_raw block-image OTA support
